system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Lucy Park created the tmp.rwong domain account at 13:44 UTC; the creation event identifies Lucy Park as the subject.
The account was added to the Temp-Staff group shortly after creation.
The account name and observed Temp-Staff membership are consistent with the stated temporary-account process, so the creation alone does not establish malicious activity.
A UserAssist registry value on WS-LPARK-01 contains an encoded path corresponding to PowerShell; this indicates Explorer tracked that path, but does not reveal the command or what PowerShell did.
Lucy Park launched cmd.exe and then OpenSSH ssh.exe from WS-LPARK-01.

The SSH process resolved PROXY-HD-01 and initiated a TCP connection from WS-LPARK-01 to that host on port 22. This is unexplained by the stated approved remote-administration practice, but the network event does not establish successful authentication or a completed session.
The Edge connection from WS-LPARK-01 to the proxy on port 8080 is consistent with use of the organization's explicit web proxy and is not, by itself, evidence of malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show an SSH TCP connection attempt, but contain no proxy-side SSH authentication or session records to determine whether it succeeded (T018-00011, T018-00012, T018-00013).
The PowerShell-related evidence is a UserAssist registry value, not a process-creation record or command line, so the executed command and its effects are unknown (T018-00001).
The supplied records do not show whether tmp.rwong subsequently logged on or what group memberships the account had beyond the observed Temp-Staff addition (T018-00003, T018-00004).
claims_not_established: Whether the SSH attempt authenticated, opened a session, or accessed any resources on PROXY-HD-01 (T018-00011, T018-00012, T018-00013).
What PowerShell command, if any, Lucy Park executed and whether it was related to account creation or the SSH attempt (T018-00001).
Whether tmp.rwong was used after creation, or whether it received any other privileges or group memberships (T018-00003, T018-00004).
Whether Lucy Park's SSH activity had an authorized business purpose.
additional_evidence_needed: PROXY-HD-01 SSH service, authentication, and session logs for the connection from WS-LPARK-01 at approximately 14:06 UTC.
Process-creation, PowerShell operational/script-block, and command-line telemetry from WS-LPARK-01 around 13:37 UTC.
Domain logon and group-membership records for tmp.rwong from account creation through the end of the review period.
Confirmation from the help desk or change/request records explaining Lucy Park's SSH activity to PROXY-HD-01.
